LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet (2 sessions) • Symbols/Characters of
Topic 3.2: Guided writing: Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided writing: Handwriting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you develop a good handwriting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the characteristics of a good handwriting

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: HANDWRITING
This lesson teaches Guided writing: Handwriting for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the characteristics of a good handwriting
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided writing: Handwriting using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided writing: Handwriting above.
2. Explain Guided writing: Handwriting to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided writing: Handwriting.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided writing: Handwriting with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided writing: Handwriting important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you develop a good handwriting?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the characteristics of a good handwriting

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
